retention.type: CT-GEL-PAD (F3): 2 gel pads, 5 mm, on the scuffed tray; no screws
retention.crash: secondary retention: one 3 mm tie or 10 mm hook-and-loop strap over the board with 1-2 mm slack so it does not short the isolation; carries the 10 N crash load if the pads release
retention.prep: IPA on the tray and the board underside; pads applied at >= 18 degC, pressed 30 s
retention.inspection: pre-flight: board does not lift with 1 finger; replace pads after a crash
